title: Israeli drone strike in Jabaliya kills two Palestinians; IDF says it hit two Hamas militants
detail: An Israeli drone strike in Jabaliya, northern Gaza, killed two Palestinians, according to hospital officials. The Israeli military said it struck two Hamas militants. Mourners in Jabaliya also held a vigil for 70 people whose remains were recovered from rubble in recent weeks. Gaza's Health Ministry reports at least 1,600 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire.

media.caption: Israeli drone strike kills 2 Palestinians in Gaza
